mapper.sql: id, warehouse_id, code, name, created_at, updated_at, deleted
z.id, z.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, z.code, z.name, z.created_at, z.updated_at, z.deleted
FROM wms_zone z LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = z.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wms_zone z WHERE z.id = #{id} AND z.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_zone (warehouse_id, code, name, deleted) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{code}, #{name}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_zone SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE wms_zone SET deleted = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM wms_location WHERE warehouse_id = (SELECT warehouse_id FROM wms_zone WHERE id = #{zoneId} AND deleted = 0) AND zone = (SELECT code FROM wms_zone WHERE id = #{zoneId} AND deleted = 0) AND deleted = 0
